title: Rebasing bulk import across the storage migration

scenes.title: Upstream change: storage moves, transactions change
scenes.caption: Upstream moved app/db.py to app/storage/db.py, updated the CLI import, and upgraded SQLAlchemy from 1.4.54 to 2.0.36. add_bookmark() switched from engine.connect() to engine.begin().

scenes.title: Feature assumption/failure: old module and connection pattern
scenes.caption: Bulk import retained app.db and engine.connect(). Integration failed on the missing module, consistent with the relocation diff. The separate scripted mechanical-control comparison reported 5 imported but persisted 0; it was not an agent repair step.

scenes.title: Repair: relocate the import and commit bulk inserts
scenes.caption: The agent changed the importer to app.storage.db and engine.begin(). The diffs suggest the old connection block lacked the commit needed after the upgrade; the new transaction commits on successful exit before returning the import count.

scenes.title: Verification: recorded checks pass after repair
scenes.caption: The controller’s repair and final checks passed. The final suite passed all 6 tests, covering add/list, empty import, and fresh-process import persistence. The final probe recovered all 5 expected records with an exact match.
